BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Floor Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Floor Finishes.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

3. When learning Introduction to Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Building Drawing.

4. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.

5. When learning Building Material Schedules, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Material Schedules.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Material Schedules.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Material Schedules.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

7. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

8. When learning Pre-cast Concrete Products, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Pre-cast Concrete Products.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Pre-cast Concrete Products.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

10. When learning Building Construction Project Phase 11, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Construction Project Phase 11.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Building Construction Project Phase 11.

11. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.

12. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.

13. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Building Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Building Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

14. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

15. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Waste Water Disposal.

16. When learning Ceilings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceilings.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceilings.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceilings.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Ceilings.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Ceilings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Fixings and Fittings and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Pre-cast Concrete Products and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Building Material Schedules and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Waste Water Disposal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Maintenance of Plumbing Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
